method: read-only source inspection; no builds or tests run

findings.kimi_feature: API 概述 / OpenAI 兼容端点
findings.allternit_equivalent: Allternit LLM Gateway exposes POST /v1/chat/completions and GET /v1/models with OpenAI-shaped request/response types.
findings.notes: Public router uses virtual-key auth, rate limit, DLP, and budget middleware; supports streaming and non-streaming completions.

findings.kimi_feature: 创建对话补全 (chat completions)
findings.allternit_equivalent: proxy::chat_completions handler backed by the Gizzi runtime.
findings.notes: Supports OpenAI-compatible request fields (model, messages, temperature, top_p, max_tokens, stop, stream, response_format, tools, tool_choice, user).

findings.kimi_feature: 列出模型 (list models)
findings.allternit_equivalent: GET /v1/models returns a flattened provider/model catalog plus policy aliases.
findings.notes: Policy aliases include auto, allternit-balanced, allternit-code, allternit-reasoning, allternit-knowledge, allternit-instruct.

findings.kimi_feature: 计算 Token (token estimation)
findings.allternit_equivalent: No platform endpoint for counting or estimating tokens.
findings.notes: Open-connector's openai.get_input_token_counts action can count tokens against OpenAI's API, but there is no Allternit-native /v1/tokenizers/estimate-token-count equivalent.

findings.kimi_feature: 文件接口 (file upload / list / retrieve / delete / content)
findings.allternit_equivalent: Workspace upload and file APIs exist, but not a model-facing /v1/files lifecycle with purpose=batch/file-extract.
findings.notes: POST /api/v1/uploads stages attachments; /api/v1/files/* provides workspace file CRUD. Open-connector can proxy OpenAI file/batch operations, but Allternit has no native purpose-driven file API for model use.

findings.kimi_feature: 批处理任务 (batch jobs: create / list / retrieve / cancel)
findings.allternit_equivalent: No native /v1/batches API. Open-connector can call OpenAI batch endpoints on the user's behalf.
findings.notes: Connector-level batch proxy is present, but the platform does not expose its own asynchronous batch inference API.

findings.kimi_feature: 查询余额 (balance)
findings.allternit_equivalent: GET /me/usage returns plan, weeklyUsed, weeklyLimit, credits; gateway budgets and per-key spend exist.
findings.notes: No single Kimi-style /v1/users/me/balance endpoint. Usage is split across /me/usage, /gateway/budgets, and per-key monthly budgets.

findings.kimi_feature: 常见错误码说明 (error responses)
findings.allternit_equivalent: OpenAI-shaped error bodies with type, message, param, code.
findings.notes: Gateway returns invalid_request_error, invalid_api_key, rate_limit_exceeded, upstream_error, server_error in OpenAI-compatible shape.

findings.kimi_feature: 限速 (rate limits)
findings.allternit_equivalent: Per-key sliding-window RPM limits and monthly/tenant budget caps.
findings.notes: Default 600 RPM per key, overridable via rate_limit_rpm. Rate-limit responses include Retry-After.

findings.kimi_feature: 快速开始 / SDK 安装
findings.allternit_equivalent: TS/Node packages (@allternit/sdk, @allternit/api-client) and the gizzi-code CLI exist; Python SDK is computer-use only.
findings.notes: No public pip-installable Allternit platform Python SDK. Some top-tier provider harness paths in the SDK are stubs.

findings.kimi_feature: 配置多轮对话参数
findings.allternit_equivalent: Chat UI and message types support multi-turn message lists; runtime maintains session history.
findings.notes: Clients maintain messages arrays; gateway supports x-allternit-session-id for session reuse.

findings.kimi_feature: 使用 Kimi API 完成工具调用 (tool_calls)
findings.allternit_equivalent: Full tool-call lifecycle with approval, execution, and result capture; orchestrator loop feeds results back into history.
findings.notes: Tool calls are validated at the OpenAI gateway but executed by Gizzi's agent loop, not forwarded through the gateway.

findings.kimi_feature: 工具调用约束 (tool_choice auto/none/required/function)
findings.allternit_equivalent: Tool registry supports native, mcp, custom, and kernel tools; governance defines approval tiers.
findings.notes: Allowed-tools and governance tiers provide equivalent control, though not via the exact OpenAI tool_choice shape.

findings.kimi_feature: 使用 Kimi API 的联网搜索功能 ($web_search)
findings.allternit_equivalent: webSearch tool implemented in the Research plugin using public APIs and Computer Use SDK.
findings.notes: Allternit exposes webSearch as a first-class tool rather than a magic $web_search formula.

findings.kimi_feature: 使用 response_format 控制模型输出格式 / JSON Mode
findings.allternit_equivalent: Gateway parses response_format; structured output schemas exist for agents and local models.
findings.notes: No top-level chat-completion enforcement of json_object/json_schema was found in the main gateway proxy. Structured output is primarily agent/skill/local-model metadata.

findings.kimi_feature: 使用 Kimi API 的 Partial Mode
findings.allternit_equivalent: No partial/best-of/n-sampling mode in the platform chat/orchestration APIs.
findings.notes: Only found in gizzi-code SDK provider code, not exposed as a platform capability.

findings.kimi_feature: 推理强度 / 思考模型 (reasoning_effort / thinking)
findings.allternit_equivalent: Reasoning content is streamed and displayed; a routing policy alias selects reasoning-optimized models.
findings.notes: Allternit surfaces reasoning/thinking deltas and has an allternit-reasoning policy, but no user-facing reasoning_effort parameter matching Kimi K3.

findings.kimi_feature: 配置 Kimi 视觉模型 / 多模态图片输入
findings.allternit_equivalent: Message parts support image URLs; model catalog flags vision support; chat composer supports image attachments.
findings.notes: Gateway accepts typed content parts but content_text() currently replaces non-text parts with placeholders before forwarding to Gizzi.

findings.kimi_feature: 多模态视频输入
findings.allternit_equivalent: Real-time vision/audio WebSocket streaming component exists; artifact kinds include video.
findings.notes: MultimodalInput is wired to /api/v1/multimodal/ws; video as a chat attachment is partially supported through file uploads.

findings.kimi_feature: 使用 Kimi API 进行文件问答 (file-based Q&A)
findings.allternit_equivalent: Memory agent ingests files and answers questions; chat composer supports attachments.
findings.notes: Files are ingested into the memory agent and queried via RAG-style retrieval.

findings.kimi_feature: 使用 Kimi API 的 Context Caching 功能
findings.allternit_equivalent: No cache_control or context-cache API. Pricing schema includes cache-read/write cost fields.
findings.notes: Allternit models price fields for prompt caching but does not expose a context-caching feature.

findings.kimi_feature: 使用 Batch API 批量处理任务
findings.allternit_equivalent: No native batch inference API; only swarm agent batch UI operations and OpenAI connector batch proxy.
findings.notes: BatchToolbar is for restarting/stopping multiple swarm agents, not LLM batch jobs.

findings.kimi_feature: 动态加载工具
findings.allternit_equivalent: MCP app bridge and tool registry support dynamic tool listing, calling, and context updates.
findings.notes: MCP servers can be registered at runtime; tools are listed and invoked through the bridge.

findings.kimi_feature: 自动断线重连
findings.allternit_equivalent: Gizzi event bus maintains a reconnecting SSE connection to the runtime.
findings.notes: Stream adapter handles SSE deltas and reconnection is built into the Gizzi bus.

findings.kimi_feature: Prompt 最佳实践
findings.allternit_equivalent: Documentation exists for prompt styles and agent preferences.
findings.notes: Best-practice documentation is Kimi-specific guidance, not a platform capability.

findings.kimi_feature: 基准测试最佳实践
findings.allternit_equivalent: LLM gateway router uses benchmark scores (humaneval, mmlu, gpqa, gsm8k, arena_elo, aider) to rank models.
findings.notes: Allternit consumes benchmark data for routing, but does not publish benchmark best-practice guides.

findings.kimi_feature: 账号与财务 / 建立并认证你的组织
findings.allternit_equivalent: Workspaces, organization members, invites, cloud credentials, and billing dashboards exist.
findings.notes: Workspaces and org management are present, but there is no full Kimi-style organization/project/limit API.

findings.kimi_feature: 在 Claude Code / Codex CLI / Kimi Code CLI / Gizzi Code / Hermes Agent / OpenClaw 中使用 Kimi
findings.allternit_equivalent: Allternit ships gizzi-code CLI and has Claude integration planning docs; no Kimi-branded distribution guides.
findings.notes: gizzi-code is the native CLI agent. Third-party IDE/agent integration docs exist for Claude but are not yet shipped as public guides for Codex/Gizzi Code/Hermes/OpenClaw.

findings.kimi_feature: 在 Playground 中配置 MCP 服务器 / 使用 Playground 调试模型
findings.allternit_equivalent: MCP configuration and tool registry are present; the Playground UI is demo-only and not wired to real inference.
findings.notes: usePlaygroundManager simulates streaming with setInterval and fake artifacts. MCP configuration is real in chat/agent flows.

findings.kimi_feature: Kimi K3 / K2.6 / K2.7 Code / Moonshot V1 模型
findings.allternit_equivalent: Allternit is model-agnostic; no Kimi proprietary models.
findings.notes: Kimi model families are Kimi-specific. Allternit can route to Kimi via the OpenAI-compatible endpoint if a provider connector exists.

findings.kimi_feature: 模型推理价格说明 / 各模型定价
findings.allternit_equivalent: Per-model cost fields and server-side pricing recompute are stored in usage events.
findings.notes: Pricing is provider/model-specific and recomputed server-side; no unified public pricing page was found.

findings.kimi_feature: 批量推理定价
findings.allternit_equivalent: No native batch inference API, therefore no batch pricing.
findings.notes: Open-connector batch proxy passes through provider pricing.

findings.kimi_feature: 联网搜索定价 / 工具定价
findings.allternit_equivalent: Tool/web-search usage is tracked but no separate public pricing model.
findings.notes: Pricing schema has input/output/cache fields only; no tool surcharge field.

findings.kimi_feature: 充值与限速
findings.allternit_equivalent: Per-key RPM limits, monthly budgets, tenant hard caps, and usage dashboards.
findings.notes: Limits are key/tenant-scoped rather than tier-based.

findings.kimi_feature: 主要概念 / 模型列表 / 快速开始
findings.allternit_equivalent: README, REPO_STRUCTURE, service docs, and model catalog.
findings.notes: Allternit docs describe the layered architecture and service ports.

findings.kimi_feature: 平台新功能发布记录 / 研究笔记
findings.allternit_equivalent: No centralized platform changelog or research-notes publication.
findings.notes: Individual specs and ADRs exist in docs/, but no equivalent to Kimi's public changelog page.

findings.kimi_feature: Kimi 开放平台服务协议 / 隐私政策 / 充值协议
findings.allternit_equivalent: Allternit-specific legal terms are outside the scope of this technical parity audit.
findings.notes: Legal agreements are vendor-specific and not platform capabilities.

top_gaps: No native /v1/batches asynchronous batch inference API (only OpenAI connector proxy).
No token-count/estimate endpoint in the Allternit platform API.
No purpose-driven /v1/files lifecycle for model use (batch, file-extract).
No context-caching / prompt-caching feature exposed to callers.
No Partial Mode / n-sampling in the platform chat/orchestration APIs.
Playground UI is demo-only and not connected to real inference.
No public platform changelog or research-notes page.
SDK support is fragmented: no full Python platform SDK and some TS provider stubs.
quick_wins: Promote the existing OpenAI-compatible gateway /v1/chat/completions as the primary external API.
Surface per-key usage and budgets through a single /v1/balance-shaped endpoint.
Wire the existing response_format parsing into JSON-mode enforcement.
Replace the simulated Playground streaming with a real call to /v1/chat/completions.
Add a token-count endpoint that calls Gizzi's tokenizer or provider tokenizers.
Document Claude/Codex/Gizzi Code integration using the existing OpenAI-compatible base URL.
extra_allternit_capabilities: Computer Use desktop + browser hybrid automation (53-command macOS accessibility adapter plus Playwright/CDP/browser-use).
MCP server/client bridge with dynamic tool loading.
Rails DAG/WIH execution backend for agents.
Memory agent with file ingestion, vector search, and consolidation.
Governance/policy engine with trust tiers, tool approvals, and gate/review flows.
A2A agent cards with input/output schemas.
